svg.text: Audio DSL benchmark on x86-64 Linux
Speed relative to the fastest Faust build of the same contract (the ×1 line): up, faster than Faust; down, slower. Log scale.
Strict FTZ/DAZgeometric means: Onda ×1.56 · Cmajor ×0.74 · YDSP ×0.25 · C++ ×0.94
fast-mathgeometric means: Onda ×1.30 · Cmajor ×0.63 · YDSP ×0.30 · C++ ×0.81
Intel Core i9-14900HX · f32 · 48 kHz · 256-frame blocks. Cmajor uses its faster backend (C++ or LLVM JIT).
Bars outside the axis range are clipped.
